content:
**Iguana Soup** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A bowl of soup containing chopped up pieces of iguana meat and some vegetables.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (2) Iguana Bits (2) Silt Bean (2) Spices (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Iguana Soup | | Iguana Soup (1) | 

Prior to Fallout 76 patch 1.2.1.18, crafting iguana soup required three Squirrel Bits rather than Iguana Bits.
